summary: SENTINEL is an offline-capable, local-first health monitoring cockpit designed for astronauts on long-duration exploration missions (e.g., Artemis, Mars transit). Far from mission control and facing signal transmission latency up to 20 minutes each way, astronauts must act as their own primary health responders. SENTINEL continuously synthesizes physiological telemetry, daily subjective check-ins, psychomotor vigilance tests (PVT), exercise countermeasures, and environmental cabin sensors against context-aware personal baselines, providing explainable early warnings and SBAR-structured clinical escalation packets.
